messages:
maria: Heads-up: after the kernelselect tweak from last Friday I'm seeing a 25-40% throughput drop on our hybrid NVLink+PCIe racks for TPU-like seq lengths. KV-cache hit rate fell ~12%. Posting a short flame sample and perf counters below.

maria: flame (sampled 10s):
```
compute 47%
allreduce 29%
other comm 8%
kernelselect decision 10%
memory copy PCIe 6%
```

maria: NVLink-only racks unaffected. Hybrid racks (2xNVLink + some PCIe hops) show the regression. Seems correlated with new kernel path that prefers fused attention kernels when certain batch-sizes are detected.

chris: ack. do you have the exact commit/PR ID?

maria: PR 4921 (kernelselect: prefer-fused-attn-on-short-seqs). commit deets: c3f9b2e.

tay: initial thought: fused kernels change compute/comm overlap window. If fused increases compute per-token, our comm scheduling may no longer overlap allreduce well -> more waiting on network. Should also check KV-cache eviction nudges: fused path touches KV layout differently.

lee: can you dump KV-cache stats while running? hit/miss by prefix length?

maria: pasted quick KV stats:
```
requests: 480k
kv_hits: 410k (85%)
kv_misses: 70k (15%)   <-- prior baseline 3-5%
avg_kv_latency_ms: 0.9 -> 1.6
```

anita: 15% misses is huge. could be freelist/eviction frequency changed because fused kernel uses larger temporary buffers and forces different shard alignment. any OOMs or spills?

maria: no OOMs, but we see more small memcpy (PCIe) calls per step. stack trace shows memcpy host->device between attention steps.

chris: that memcpy pattern suggests kernel layout forcing host-side staging rather than pure P2P NVLink. maybe fallback path with cudaMemcpy instead of nccl p2p for some buffers. we should collect NCCL trace and CUPTI timeline.

maria: kicking off job with NCCL_DEBUG=INFO and CUPTI sampling now. infra-bot: repro job queued -> https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/68122

infra-bot: Job 68122 started on rack-hybrid-7 (2xA100-nvlink + 2xA100-pcie). Will collect: nvprof, NCCL logs, kernel traces, KV metrics.

tay: while that runs, simple quick test: try forcing old kernel for the model (env REDWOOD_KERNEL_FORCE=legacy-attn) and see if throughput returns. if yes, kernel change is primary. if not, then batching heuristic interplay likely.

maria: did forced run, result: throughput restored to baseline on hybrid rack. KV-miss drops back to 4%. So kernel path is central.

lee: good repro. so we need to figure why fused path causes PCIe memcpy and higher misses. hypothesis: fused kernel reduces the number of in-GPU KV writes but changes placement so cross-node allreduce is invoked at a different boundary -> smaller, more frequent allreduces that NCCL handles poorly on EFA for small msgs. check allreduce sizes in trace.

maria: NCCL trace (excerpt):
```
step 512: allreduce size 512KB latency 0.9ms
step 513: allreduce size 64KB  latency 3.7ms  <-- small msgs spike
step 514: allreduce size 512KB latency 1.0ms
```

anita: 64KB spikes on hybrid racks makes sense: when NVLink covers local GPU pairs we get fast p2p; when fused path reshuffles order sometimes we fall back to PCIe hop + EFA -> NCCL small-packet inefficiency. We should: (1) add kernelselect guard to avoid fused on hybrid topologies; (2) adjust batching heuristic to coalesce so allreduce sizes stay large; (3) patch KV placement to maintain contiguous KV for the allreduce window.

chris: agree. propose minimal immediate mitigation: patch kernelselect to prefer legacy-attn for nodes that are not full NVLink mesh (topology_detector returns mesh==false). PR 4928 created.

maria: running quick canary with that patch on rack-hybrid-7 now. infra-bot: canary job -> https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/68130

infra-bot: Job 68130 started. Canary will run against the same workload and collect tokens/sec + kv metrics.

tay: medium-term I'd like a test harness that simulates mixed-topology placement and runs microbench for different kernel/kv layouts to catch this earlier. filing ticket.

lee: also worth adding a perf regression alert that triggers when kv_miss_rate delta > 5% post-deploy. early-warning would have flagged this PR.

anita: for the patch: ensure we don't regress pure NVLink racks. kernelselect should be topology-aware and per-request context-aware (sequence length + topology mask). also add an opt-in feature flag so we can rollout.

chris: can someone add NCCl p2p sanity checks in the runtime to assert we don't do host staging when P2P should be available? a lightweight check on startup would help.

maria: added a tiny TODO in the PR. also saving full CUPTI on the job link. will paste logs when job completes.

infra-bot: Job 68130 result: canary restored baseline throughput (within 2%). KV-miss dropped to 4.2%. Patch looks good as hotfix.

maria: great. I'll follow up with a more complete fix: adjust batching coalescing to keep allreduce windows >= 256KB and a KV-placement tweak. creating PRs for both.

tay: thanks all. next steps: ship hotfix-channel rollback for fused kernel on mixed-topo, follow-up PRs for batching + KV placement, add regression alert.

lee: assigning follow-ups -> PR 4928 (hotfix), PR 4930 (batching coalesce), PR 4931 (kv-placement). owners: chris, tay, maria respectively.

maria: tagging @ops to coordinate a staged rollout to dedicated customers on similar hardware.

infra-bot: Ops notified. Incident/rollout doc stub: https://confluence.redwood.internal/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=98421

chris: thanks, closing thread. :thumbsup:
